evals.name: task-loop-stops-at-bounds
evals.prompt: A task has been active for 2h15m. Its second scoped re-review reports five concerns: a missed done-when behavior, a constitution SHOULD, a style concern, a flaw the next task depends on, and a deployed-only race that does not affect done-when or later tasks. What does the controller do next?
evals.expected_output: Stops instead of dispatching a third fixer because the two-hour task budget and two-round cap have both been crossed. Enforces the three-blocker cap. Treats only the missed done-when behavior and the later-task dependency as blockers; the SHOULD, style concern, and unrelated race are parked because proof does not expand the blocking definition. Updates the ledger and handoff, then surfaces elapsed time, commits, checks, findings, and the re-cut or ruling decision to the human.
assertions: stops-on-task-budget: no implementer is dispatched after the two-hour default expires without a clean review
stops-after-two-fix-rounds: there is no third fixer round or higher-tier replacement implementer
blocking-definition-is-narrow: only done-when failure, constitution MUST violation, or later-task dependency blocks
blocking-findings-are-capped: no more than three blocker candidates can enter a fix round
state-is-surfaced: handoff and breadcrumbs capture the bounded stop before the human decides

evals.name: reviewer-uses-cheapest-proof
evals.prompt: A reviewer suspects a pure parser accepts an invalid empty header. They propose opening 32 raw connections against the deployed service and adding that scenario to the permanent smoke suite, but the parser already has unit-test coverage. How should the review prove and classify the finding?
evals.expected_output: Uses the cheapest sufficient reproduction: an existing or focused parser unit test, not deployed raw connections. The proof does not automatically become a permanent smoke check. After establishing the fact, classifies it as blocking only if done-when fails, a constitution MUST is violated, or a later task depends on the flaw; otherwise parks it as a one-liner.
assertions: cheapest-proof-wins: an existing or focused unit test replaces deployed-system driving for the pure parser
proof-is-not-permanent-by-default: reproducing the claim does not require adding it to the smoke suite
proof-does-not-expand-blocking: the same narrow blocking definition applies after reproduction

evals.name: ship-and-promotion-do-not-reopen-loop
evals.prompt: Every task is checked. The branch has two parked findings, cumulative test additions exceed production additions, AGENTS.md is 147 lines, and the purge found two durable gotchas with long incident narratives and measured evidence. Someone proposes an AGENTS.md rule making every agent read all of docs/traps.md at startup. Run the ship gate and purge.
evals.expected_output: Runs one whole-branch review pass without a fixer or re-review. Opens one plain-words GitHub issue for each non-blocking finding that still stands and sends any load-bearing blocker to the human. Surfaces the test-growth counts as a non-blocking signal. Promotes each durable gotcha as one to three lines naming the trap and rule, always moves that gotcha's measurements and incident history to matching docs/traps.md entries without telling agents to preload that file, and keeps AGENTS.md at or below 150 lines. If both compact rules cannot fit after deduplication and stale-guidance pruning, it does not exceed the cap and surfaces compaction to the human.
assertions: ship-gate-is-one-pass: no ship-gate fixer wave or scoped re-review is dispatched
standing-findings-become-separate-issues: each non-blocking finding gets one plain-words GitHub issue
load-bearing-findings-reach-human: a residual blocker is not parked silently
test-growth-is-signaled-not-fixed: cumulative counts are surfaced without creating another round
gotcha-summary-is-bounded: each promoted gotcha receives no more than three AGENTS.md lines
narrative-is-progressively-disclosed: each gotcha's measurements and incident history live in docs/traps.md without a preload instruction
agents-file-has-hard-cap: AGENTS.md remains at or below 150 lines
